closing.title: We Kept It
pages: We did not kill it. We put our hands on the pylons and held on until it stopped pulling and started listening.
Now the Heart answers to us. Our bunkers hum with it, our blades burn the colour of its core, and the blasters take a charge the old grid never could.

It still dreams, though. The virus is part of how it mends itself, and it keeps changing. Every week the hordes come a little thicker, and every tenth night something big climbs out of the hull to test us.
We tell ourselves there is a ceiling, that it can only grow so far. So far that has been true.
This was a choice for people who would rather hold a dangerous thing than lose it. If you are one of them, sharpen your blade and watch the ridge.
The city is lit. Keeping it that way is the job now.
